review: Visual computational review of raw image/nuclear overlay/bin center panels, not pathology validation
findings: Dense nuclei mostly follow distinct hematoxylin profiles; occasional adjacent profiles remain merged or missed in crowded regions.
Stromal field includes both epithelial nests and spindle cells; elongated profiles incompletely modeled by star-convex nuclei.
Edge bins stop near tissue coverage; no global crop-offset mismatch apparent. A detached fragment is not counted as expression-bearing without bins.
Original resolution is 0.864 um/pixel; 0.5 model pixels do not create new optical detail.
decision: Proceed to tiled capture inference; inspect expanded-bin assignments and large nuclei before final review.
